'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 John Anderson DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
